name: Bulk High-Value Users
description: Find the records worth reviewing first. Combine high-end device characteristics with recent network activity to return a yes/no potential high-value-user signal for service, membership and campaign prioritization; it is a detection signal, not proof of income or purchase.

result_fields.name: Mobile Number
result_fields.description: The mobile number associated with this check, used to match the result back to the uploaded record. It does not provide identity, device model or other personal-profile data.

result_fields.name: Result
result_fields.description: A yes/no supporting signal derived from high-end device characteristics and recent network activity. It can guide review priority but does not confirm income, assets, purchasing capacity or actual spend.
